name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project located in the Salta and Catamarca provinces of Argentina. The Diablillos project is fully permitted with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study, positioning the company as a near-term silver producer targeting first production in 2029. AbraSilver graduated from the TSX Venture Exchange to the Toronto Stock Exchange in February 2025.
